title: Everyday (messages, calendar, places, home)
about: Everyday requests a phone assistant handles (messages, calendar, reminders, contacts, places nearby, home), checked against what Xod's router and planner decide, with the This Mac connector connected. want: the This Mac tool(s) that should come first; never: tools that must not. Unlocking must go through home_security_shortcut, which always asks.

cases.q: text Sam that I'm running 10 minutes late
what did mom say in her last message?
add lunch with Priya on Friday at 1pm to my calendar
remind me to call the dentist at 5pm
add Jordan Lee, 555-0134, to my contacts
find a coffee shop near me
turn off the living room lights
set the house to movie time
what's the weather in Lisbon today?
